about.description: I am language and framework agnostic engineer who loves to solve real world problems with technology. Currently I work as an SDE-III with expertise in AI/ML, App Development (Flutter/Dart) and SaaS Products. My prime domains of expertise are Fintech, Quantitative Finance, eCommerce, and IoT. I'm also deeply involved in the community, leading the TensorFlow User Group (TFUG) in Hyderabad. I love building high-performance technical solutions and occasionally write about Machine Learning and mobile development on Medium.
